title: Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into functional airway basal stem cells
protocol: Digest Matrigel to release organoids.
Remove media and add 0.5 mL Dispase (1U/mL) per well.
Dislodge Matrigel droplets mechanically using a pipette tip but without pipetting.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min in a humidified incubator.
Pipette Dispase and Matrigel together several times to break down the Matrigel until no longer visible by eye.
Incubate again at 37°C for approximately 30 min to 1 h in a humidified incubator.
Confirm under a light microscope that there is no visible Matrigel remaining.
If any, incubate an additional 15–30 min.
Dilute with DMEM/F-12 (1 mL or more/well).
Transfer to a 15 or 50 mL conical tube and pellet organoids by centrifugation at 200–300 g for 3–5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Incubate Matrigel with Dispase for 30 minutes before pipetting.
Dissociate organoids to single cells using 1 mL of 0.05% trypsin per harvested well.
Gently pipette or invert the tube and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Invert the tube several times to mix, avoiding cell aggregation, and incubate for another 5 minutes.
Confirm that most clumps are not visible.
Neutralize trypsin with an equal volume of DMEM/F-12 supplemented with 10% FBS.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 300 g for 5 minutes.
Treat 1 mL of ReLeSR per well to further dissociate small clumps to single cells at approximately 22°C for 10 minutes.
Occasionally invert the tube to mix.
Dilute ReLeSR with an equal or greater volume of DMEM/F-12 and pass cells through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Count the cells after passing them through the cell strainer.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend in FACS buffer plus live or dead cell dye.
Analyze with flow cytometry.
Spin down 105 single cells on a charged slide mounted in a cytospin funnel at 100 g for 5 min.
Remove the funnel and let cells dry for 30 s to 1 min.
Fix the cells on the slide with 4% PFA in PBS for 15 min.
Wash the cells three times with PBS.
Permeabilize the cells with 0.3% triton X in PBS for 15 min.
Block the sample with 2% BSA solution at approximately 22°C for 1 h.
Immunolabel samples with primary antibodies against NKX2-1 (1:500) and TP63 (1:200) in 2% BSA solution at approximately 4°C for 16 h or at approximately 22°C for 1 h.
Wash three times for 5 min with PBS.
Incubate samples with secondary antibodies, Alexa488-Donkey anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa555-donkey anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in 2% BSA solution at approximately 22°C for 1 h.
Wash three times for 5 min with PBS.
Mount with ProLong Gold Antifade Mountant with DAPI, seal with a coverslip and cure for 24 h before imaging.
Quantify the cells that are NKX2-1 and TP63 positive in their nuclei.
Obtain single cells from hPSC-derived airway epithelial organoids.
Sort live NKX2-1GFP+ cells that co-express TP63tdTomato+ live cells.
Replate 20,000 NKX2-1GFP+/TP63tdTomato+ cells in a 25–50 μL Matrigel droplet per well of a 12-well plate at 400 - 800 cells per μL of Matrigel.
Incubate the culture plate in a humidified incubator for 10-20 minutes.
Add 1 ml FGF2+10+DCI+Y medium per well to the re-plated cells.
Feed the culture every 2-3 days with basal cell medium.
Culture the cells approximately 9 days or longer in basal cell medium.
Resuspend single cells in FACS buffer.
Stain cells with NGFR antibody (1:100) and EpCAM antibody, 1:100 in 50 μL of FACS buffer per 1 million cells for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash and resuspend in FACS buffer + 10 μM Y-27632 (5 to 10 million cells/mL) + live or dead cell dye.
Sort NKX2-1GFP+, TP63tdTomato+, and NGFR+ (and EpCAM+) population to isolate iBC.
Re-plate 20,000 sorted cells in a 25–50 μL Matrigel droplet per well of 12 well plate at 400–800 cells per μL of Matrigel.
Place the culture plate in a humidified incubator for 10–20 min and then add 1 mL basal medium per well.
Feed every 2–3 days.
Sort iBCs for experiments requiring ALI culture when necessary.
Passage iBCs every 10–14 days as required.
Plate single cells after each passaging if high percentage of iBCs is maintained in the culture.
Perform additional NGFR (and EpCAM) sorts to enrich for iBCs and remove differentiated cells from culture.
Check purity of non-reporter iPSC-derived iBCs using NKX2-1 and TP63 co-expression analysis.
Prepare cytospin samples for immunofluorescence staining after sorting non-reporter iPSC-derived iBCs.
Block mouse antibodies used for sorting with MOM (Mouse On Mouse) blocking reagent before step 5f.
Cryopreserve iBCs to avoid redoing the differentiation protocol for every experiment.
Obtain single cells from airway epithelial organoids cultured in basal cell medium.
Resuspend single cells in basal cell medium supplemented with 10% dimethylsulfoxide (DMSO) at a density of 200,000–500,000 cells per mL.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a cryovial (1 mL per vial).
Place the vials in cryostorage containers and cool in a −80°C freezer at −1°C/min for 24 hours.
Transfer the cooled vials to −150°C freezer or into liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Plate 200,000 cells in a 50 μL Matrigel droplet per well of a 12-well plate at a density of 4,000 cells per μL.
Incubate the plate in a humidified incubator for 10–20 minutes.
Add 1 mL basal medium to each well.
Feed the culture every 2–3 days.
Dissociate organoids into single cells after 3–4 days following steps 1 through 3.
Re-plate 20,000 live cells in a 50 μL Matrigel droplet per well of a 12-well plate at a density of 400 cells per μL.
Place the re-plated culture plate in a humidified incubator for 15–30 minutes.
Add 1 mL basal medium to each well after the incubation period.
Feed the culture every 2–3 days.
Incubate iBCs for 10–14 days until they are ready to expand or sort for further experiments.
Coat 6.5 mm Transwell inserts with hES-qualified Matrigel.
Plate 150,000-200,000 iBCs sorted from Day 40, expansion, or cryopreservation on the apical chamber of an insert in basal cell medium.
Add 500–600 μL of basal cells medium to the basolateral chamber.
Place the culture plate in a humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Feed both top and bottom chambers with basal cell medium every other day.
After 4-7 days, confirm confluent or near confluent (>80%) cell monolayer.
Change the medium to PneumaCult ALI in both apical and basolateral chambers.
Remove the medium from only the top chamber the following day.
Feed the culture every other day from the bottom chamber for 2-3 weeks before use.
